scope: Cached Git source inspection, not original ZIP identity or runtime recovery proof

findings.finding: Requires reachable ADB, product property and root before recovery writes; not a standalone BootROM rescue.
Root fallback retries without an attempt/deadline bound; helper availability and current-build root success are not established.
Reads current first 34 sectors then unpatches that GPT; not acquisition of the pre-change full user or boot regions.
Writes packaged recovery then primary GPT, conditionally backup GPT when local offset exceeds threshold; no post-write readback/hash check appears in this selected script.
Requests reboot to Amazon Recovery; command issuance does not prove recovery entry or sideload compatibility.
